mission: Frank v0.1 voll lauffähig auf Andreas PC

supported_points: Lark terminal priorities participate in lexical choice and strict mode is the required collision/follow-conflict falsifier for the candidate grammar family.
Ignored trivia and parse-tree rule/alias context are semantic integration details for this LALR frontend; post-parse consumers must not replace grammar context with global token-value heuristics.
Advanced regex/lookaround can reduce collision-analysis visibility, so removing lookaround is a research hypothesis only and must preserve the selected V17 language exactly before promotion.

hypothesis: A no-lookahead Needle relation membrane may replace V17 only if it is strict-LALR clean and preserves every selected V17 qid/call/relation/trivia semantic boundary plus downstream typed-IR behavior.
strongest_counterhypothesis: Special high-priority Needle terminals cannot safely approximate the V17 identifier boundary: each attempted simplification may steal a valid qid continuation or trivia case even when common alphanumeric suffix fuzz passes.

out_of_box_experiment.name: LEXICAL_BOUNDARY_CONSERVATION_SWEEP
out_of_box_experiment.result: V18 whole-prefix design refuted; V19 delimiter-consuming design refuted; V17 retained. Novelty alone did not promote architecture.

v20_new_counterexample.mechanism: V20 uses high-priority /Needle\.owns\b/. A regex word boundary occurs before '.', '-' and '?', although selected V17 can continue the qid/postfix-qid through those characters. Therefore V20 can steal a prefix that its existing owns_extra/ownsX/ownership fuzz does not cover.

wp03_latest_integrity_fusion.failure: direct_identifier trusts a single child token under ident_* without verifying alias suffix equals literal, allowing replay/corrupted-AST alias-token mismatch to fail open
wp03_latest_integrity_fusion.required_fix: For ident_* direct children require exactly one token and token value equal to alias suffix; malformed/mismatched aliases fail closed; direct NAME remains accepted.
